answer: Give each agent one harbor icehouse for 120 days. The keeper pays a 90 dollar license and locks a 150 token deposit, then cuts 40 numbered blocks for the sawdust store. Each week the keeper weighs the blocks while a neighbor signs the tally. An opal stone at the door proves each photo was taken on site, and a beacon lamp on the roof burns nightly so ships find the quay. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 icehouses freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars. A fake icehouse melts like a snowman in a furnace, leaving an empty sawdust pit.
